_note: Six Margaret River subregions, each linking to a filtered market view. Alt text describes the SCENE, never the estate: the photography is of identifiable named properties and the site must not imply they are participating suppliers.

regions.name: Wilyabrup
regions.blurb: Gravel over granite, the region's oldest cabernet blocks
regions.alt: Aerial view of a vineyard block on a valley slope beside stands of gum trees in late afternoon light

regions.name: Yallingup
regions.blurb: Exposed and maritime, thick skins and slow ripening
regions.alt: Overhead view of vineyard rows meeting mown grass and a gravel track

regions.name: Karridale
regions.blurb: The coldest fruit in the region, late picked whites
regions.alt: A line of tall gum trees and autumn coloured vines reflected in a still dam

regions.name: Cowaramup
regions.blurb: Mixed farming country, whites made to drink young
regions.alt: Sheep grazing between rows of bare winter vines

regions.name: Treeton
regions.blurb: Sheltered valley floor, small family holdings
regions.alt: Late sun breaking through the branches of paperbark trees above a vineyard

regions.name: Boranup
regions.blurb: Cut into the karri forest, cool nights and a late harvest
regions.alt: White trunked trees and fallen leaves at the edge of a green vineyard
